[b]The Return of the Sal-Baliz[/b]
At 7:20pm on 7th March, people across erene watched their TV screens as usual. Little did they know, far away a group of terrorists was plotting to make a big move. No matter what people were watching, the signal was intercepted and replaced by a rather ominous transmission. This immediately caught the attention of Hydronias government.A group of top officials crowded round a small screen, whilst others were trying to track the signal. The image on the screen was of a man. He had a rather long grey beard and was wearing a military jacket over the top of some black robes.
We are the Sal-Baliz, he said. You probably thought that we were no more. Simply a relic in the pages of history. But you are mistaken. ALL OF YOU ARE MISTAKEN! I speak to all the Muslims of erene. The Hydronian government that fought so hard to destroy us has failed you. We accept responsibility for the recent attacks on Sherman. We understand that this will make you fearful of us, but I assure you that it is for the greater good! Sherman and their allies are trying to destroy us and all of Islam! We cannot let this happen! You must return to the homeland, where you will not be kept in an anti-Islamic captivity, where you will be treated as equals. We shall spread the glory of Allah together! We shall destroy those who oppose him and show them his wrath! We shall once agai-*BRRRR* *SSSHHHHH* The transmission was blocked by the government and TV screens returned to normal, but this was not the last of the Sal-Baliz, and the world knew it.

Dear residents of the Cordone,

     It has come to my attention that the prohibition of Cordone has passed, and with that comes despair. It is currently 8:30 AM as of writing this, and my Telegram was sent directly to me 25 hours ago. Only due to notification from other people, I was able to just in time read it. This is the dismaying letter, that was not only wrote to me:

"Hello there,

It has come to the attention of the East Pacific Police Service that you are in violation of a prohibition order. As per the prohibition of Cordone, no nation may reside in both Cordone and The East Pacific at any one time. If residency in Cordone is given up, you may return to The East Pacific. Alternatively you may opt to move to Cordone, but will thereby be barred entry to The East Pacific.

We figured a personal telegram would be kinder than an ejection out of the blue, so you'll have 48 hours to rectify this before we take the necessary action(s).

Thank you for your time."

The sender went by the name "Marrabuk" Which was apart of the East Pacific Police Service, or EPPS. When I finished reading this, thousands of images from both regions flashed through my head as I tried to gather thought. "What?" I asked myself twice, "Why" thrice. I knew a couple minutes later that I, or any person could not logically answer that question. After regaining my thoughts, I knew this would either be the end of me, or the end of ME. Though I am not able to stay in both, I will always be with both. So I ask, if I leave the East Pacific: Silvamar, my last wish is to be placed on the Map of valsora, not as me, but as your colony. Yes, I am giving you my land. You may accept, or decline my wish as you like.

As for Cordone, if I may choose to stay in the East, this is my wish: Arearth. For the past week, I have been creating a new world separate from the ways of Cordone. Make it different, the code will be sent to the Cordone account. As for the war, Gendarme may annex me.

[i][b]THE STANDOFF OF CHECKPOINT VETI[/b][/i]
With the growing threat of the  Islamic Liberation Front - an organization of several armed mujahideen groups residing and operating in the Qhordestan mountains of southern Xordisia, the de facto Islamic State of South Xordisia led by the Qhordestan Interim Government established after the aftermath of the Second Xordisian Civil war which lasted for 9 years during 2001-2010 ending in a frozen conflict after the Socialist takeover of Xordisia in 2010, the government has declared the "Islamic Caliphate" established by the ILF in Qhordestan to be completely illegitimate, saying that their authority lies only in military force with limited support from the residents of Qhordestan. 

The XPG/KPG (Xordisian People's Group) and the ILF had been closely watching each other's attested borders with light armed engagements between themselves, it was not until the 7th March of 2025 when KPG humanitarian support convoys were halted by ILF forces in Checkpoint veti in the mountains, causing the KPG to send 2 tanks, 3 APCs, and 2 IFVs tasked with intimidating the ILF forces and to exercise force when provoked. This convoy arrived 34 minutes after the humanitarian support was stopped from entering the Caliphate's territories, demanding that the ILF allow entry through the checkpoint, threatening them with armed engagement.

This resulted in the ILF Special Armoured Task Force 2 (SATF-2) to respond, arriving 48 minutes after KPG's Armoured Presence with their main mission being to intimidate KPG forces into withdrawing from the checkpoint, 3 ILF tanks and 13 APCs as well as 6 IFVs held the line against the KPG. The standoff stays in place to this day with more and more authority arriving in the scene on the 9th March of 2025.
